snippet.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2 & American Truck Simulator PS5 & Xbox Reveal - Future Games Show gamescom
snippet.description:
Beep beep! SCS Software's legendary Truck Simulator games are finally coming to consoles. Watch out for more news about Euro Truck Simulator 2 & American Truck Simulator coming to PS5 and Xbox Series consoles in the near future.
